scope: Three paired development smoke runs, one pair per world, 60 s configured cap. Not full exploration or a matched-coverage dose-reduction study.

verification.scope: local full tests/dougie suite; not a claim that remote CI has run these changes

configuration.coverage_definition: Fixed 25 cm floor samples within 19 cm of fresh LiDAR returns and 15 cm of capture-time foot-support height; flat elevations require physical arrival within 35 cm in 3D and 8 cm vertically. Levels counted separately.
configuration.dose_definition: Integrated simulated true dose-equivalent proxy in micro-sieverts.
configuration.timing: Independent simulated clocks, fixed 0.5 s planning latency; curves end at each mission end.

survey_report.scope: 3D floor observations from physically reached elevations; admissibility only where known support/return routes exist
